scripts.build:all: pnpm clean && pnpm build:chrome && pnpm build:firefox
scripts.lint: eslint entrypoints src scripts tests wxt.config.ts vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts playwright.live.config.ts --max-warnings=0
scripts.format: prettier --write entrypoints src scripts tests wxt.config.ts vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts playwright.live.config.ts eslint.config.mjs prettier.config.mjs dependency-cruiser.config.cjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check entrypoints src scripts tests wxt.config.ts vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts playwright.live.config.ts eslint.config.mjs prettier.config.mjs dependency-cruiser.config.cjs
scripts.test:e2e:firefox: pnpm build:firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir .output/firefox-mv3 && tsx scripts/firefox-e2e.ts
scripts.test:e2e:firefox:ux: pnpm build:firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir .output/firefox-mv3 && tsx scripts/firefox-headed-ux.ts
scripts.test:churn:smoke: H5PLAYER_CHURN_DURATION_MS=5000 playwright test tests/e2e/extension-smoke.spec.ts --grep 'configured media churn' --workers=1
scripts.test:churn: H5PLAYER_CHURN_DURATION_MS=1800000 playwright test tests/e2e/extension-smoke.spec.ts --grep 'configured media churn' --workers=1
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:component && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:compat && pnpm test:compat:report && pnpm test:security && pnpm test:boundaries
